import os
import pandas as pd

cwd = os.getcwd()
print("CWD:", cwd)
print("Files:", os.listdir(cwd))

path = os.path.join(cwd, "budget.xlsx")
if not os.path.exists(path):
    print("budget.xlsx NOT FOUND")
    raise SystemExit(1)

all_sheets = pd.read_excel(path, sheet_name=None, header=None)
for name, df in all_sheets.items():
    print("=" * 40)
    print("Sheet:", name, "shape:", df.shape)
    print(df.to_string())

import sys
import pandas as pd

path = sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else "budget.xlsx"

xls = pd.ExcelFile(path)
print("Sheets:", xls.sheet_names)

amount_keywords = ("amount", "expense", "cost", "price", "value", "total", "budget", "spent")


def amount_col(df):
    str_cols = [c for c in df.columns if isinstance(c, str)]
    cands = [c for c in str_cols if any(k in c.lower() for k in amount_keywords)]
    num_cols = [c for c in df.columns if pd.api.types.is_numeric_dtype(df[c])]
    for c in cands:
        if c in num_cols:
            return c
    return num_cols[-1] if num_cols else None


sheet_totals = {}
for name in xls.sheet_names:
    df = pd.read_excel(xls, sheet_name=name)
    print(f"\n=== Sheet '{name}' ({df.shape[0]} rows x {df.shape[1]} cols) ===")
    print("Columns:", list(df.columns))
    print(df.to_string(index=False))

    ac = amount_col(df)
    if ac is None:
        print(f"-> No numeric amount column detected; cannot total this sheet.")
        continue
    col_sum = df[ac].sum()
    print(f"-> Amount column detected: '{ac}'")
    if df.shape[1] > 1:
        first = df.columns[0]
        try:
            by_cat = df.groupby(first)[ac].sum()
            print("Per-category totals:")
            print(by_cat.to_string())
        except Exception as e:
            print(f"(could not group by first column: {e})")
    print(f"-> Sheet '{name}' total of '{ac}': {col_sum}")
    sheet_totals[name] = col_sum

grand = sum(sheet_totals.values())
print("\nRESULT:")
for k, v in sheet_totals.items():
    print(f"  {k}: {v}")
print(f"TOTAL EXPENSES ACROSS ALL CATEGORIES: {grand}")

import pandas as pd

path = "budget.xlsx"
sheets = pd.read_excel(path, sheet_name=None, header=None)
for name, df in sheets.items():
    print(f"=== {name} shape={df.shape} ===")
    print(df.to_string(max_rows=60, max_cols=20))
